item.coloph: zhes rig 'dzin slob dpon yab yum dgyes pa'i 'bangs/ dus ngan skal khug gso ba'i dpa' bo/ rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis thugs rje yang dben dkon khrod kyi brag ri seng ge rgyab bsnol nyi 'od mtshal mdog gyis ngos nas rgyas khrol te/ skal ldan 'dus pa lnga yis dbang po'i spyod yul du gyur pa spyan drangs te/ slar dad gus mos pas rab tu gdung ba'i sdong btsun 'chi med 'jam dpal rnam rgyal gyis lo du ma nas yang nas yang du bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams kyi snyoms las pa mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pas sprul pa'i gnas chen brgyad kyi ya gyal rigs bzhi'i nang tshan rin chen rigs kyis gnas bam brag brtsegs pa rin chen 'bar ba'i 'khyil mtsho steng bde ldan gsang sngags gling gi 'chi med g.yung drung bkod pa'i gzhal med khang chen po'i gnas nang / lcags stag hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bzang por/ shog ser la spel ba la rig pa 'od gsal gyi brda don 'khrol nas gtan la dbab pa'i yi ge dang po pa g.yung drung blo gsal dbang po'i sde yis byas pa'i dge tshogs mkha' khyab yongs la bsngo zhing bstan 'dzin mchog rnams gsang gsum 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i zhabs pad bskal brgyar bstan cing gsang chen zab mo'i bstan pa phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas nas/ snyigs ma'i rgud pa tha dag myur du zhi ba'i smon pa dang bcas te tha tshan mu tsug shin//
